# Five layers in the webview, enforced not agreed

> The Rust side's boundaries are crates and a crate that imports what it may not does not compile; the webview had the same kinds of boundary and none of the enforcement.

Applies to `web/src/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **One flat components folder** (refused by `web/the-five-layers`) — Worked at nine files and stopped at thirty. Pages reached into each other and the only thing keeping a component reusable was whoever last edited it remembering that it should be.
- **Raw HTML wherever it is convenient** (refused by `web/no-raw-html-above-the-alphabet`) — A `<div className="flex gap-4">` in a page is a design decision made outside the design system. Consistency erodes one of those at a time, none wrong on its own.
- **Plain CSS with custom properties, no Tailwind** (nothing refuses it) — It is what the product had, and it worked. shadcn's components are written in utility classes, and rewriting each one by hand is a fork of upstream you then maintain forever. Tailwind is build-time only here, so nothing about the offline guarantee changes.
- **Radix headless with hand-written CSS** (nothing refuses it) — Considered and passed over: the palette was already tokens, but owning the component source is what lets archwarden govern it like anything else.
- **Base UI, the MUI headless successor** (nothing refuses it) — The API is still moving, which combines badly with a repository that pins exact versions and treats upgrades as deliberate commits.
- **Writing every primitive ourselves, no dependency** (nothing refuses it) — A correct modal is real work — focus trapped and restored, escape, scroll lock, aria — and getting it wrong is invisible until somebody uses a keyboard.
- **Testing every view file** (refused by `web/logic-is-tested-where-it-lives`) — Views are arrangement, and arrangement is checked by looking. Eleven standing warnings is how a real one gets missed.
